question: In which of the following years was the National Telecom Policy (NTP), that envisaged the objective of one public call office (PCO) for every 500 persons in the urban areas, formulated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1994**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Telecom Policy (NTP), 1994** was formulated with the objective of providing **basic telecommunication services** to all sections of society and improving rural connectivity.
 
• The policy specifically aimed to establish **one Public Call Office (PCO) for every 500 persons in urban areas**, thereby ensuring easy access to telecommunication services for the urban population.
 
• This policy was instrumental in **expanding telecom services** across India and paved the way for further reforms and privatization in the telecom sector. *Hence, statement 3 is correct.*
 
• The **NTP 1994** was a landmark policy that aimed at **reducing communication costs** while increasing the availability of telecommunication services, especially in urban areas.
 
• It also marked the beginning of the shift towards **liberalization and privatization** of India's telecom sector. *Hence, statement 3 is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Telecom Policy (NTP), 1994:**

 
 
• **Objective:** To make telecommunication services affordable and accessible to all, with a focus on improving **urban and rural connectivity**.
 
• The policy emphasized the importance of **public call offices (PCOs)** for urban areas and aimed at bridging the gap between the rural and urban telecom infrastructure.
 
• The NTP 1994 encouraged private participation in the telecom sector, opening up avenues for competition and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Subsequent Developments:**
 
 
• The success of NTP 1994 led to the formulation of **NTP 1999**, which focused on **universal service obligations** and further liberalized the telecom sector.
 
• The policies following NTP 1994 contributed to the rapid growth of telecommunication services in India, making it one of the fastest-growing telecom markets globally.
 
 
 
• **Impact of NTP 1994:**
 
 
• It played a crucial role in increasing the **penetration of telecommunication services** in urban and rural India.
 
• The policy also laid the groundwork for the technological advancements that transformed India's telecom sector into a key driver of economic growth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of NTP 1994:**

 
 
• Focused on providing **one PCO per 500 persons** in urban areas to ensure widespread access to telecommunication services.
 
• Encouraged **private sector participation** in telecom infrastructure development, fostering competition and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Significance:**
 
 
• The policy marked a shift from a government-controlled monopoly to a more **liberalized and competitive telecom market**.
 
• It played a pivotal role in driving the expansion of telecom services and connecting millions of Indians to the global communication network.
